name: badminton-motion-lab
description: Badminton Motion and Performance Intelligence Platform — local-first web + Local Agent

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bml/contracts && npm run build -w @bml/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run test -w @bml/contracts && npm run test -w @bml/web
scripts.test:agent: cd apps/agent && python -m pytest test_security.py -q && python smoke_test.py
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @bml/web && npm run test:agent && node scripts/check-no-synthetic-reports.mjs
